_README: Token price table used by agent/metrics.py to convert measured token counts
into a USD cost per turn. Prices are OPERATOR-SUPPLIED, not measured — re-verify
against the provider's current pricing page whenever `as_of` goes stale, and set
`verified_by_operator` back to false until someone actually has. See
`verification_notes` for what was checked and what it ruled out.
A model that is absent from `models` yields cost_usd = null (NOT 0.0), so an
unpriced model can never be silently reported as free.
verification_notes: Checked against the pricing page by the operator on 2026-08-25.
1. Gemini 2.5 output price INCLUDES thinking/reasoning tokens — there is no
separate reasoning rate. This matters more here than it looks: reasoning is
74-97% of output on both tiers (MEMORY.md section 1), so a separate rate would
have invalidated every cost number in this project. It does not — pricing
output_tokens at the output rate is the complete and correct calculation.
2. No context-length tiering on gemini-2.5-flash at the volumes used here.
3. Gemma has NO paid tier — the pricing page lists the paid column as unavailable.
Priced 0.0 here, which is correct, but see its note below for the consequence.

gemma-4-31b-it.note: Finalizer model — both the .env value and the code default (AgentConfig.final_model). Genuinely 0.0: Gemma has NO paid tier, it is served free only. Two consequences. (a) The two-model split looks cheap partly by construction — see counterfactual_model below before quoting a dollar saving. (b) Free-only means it keeps free-tier rate limits EVEN on a billing-enabled project, so the finalizer, not the paid router, is now the component that can hit a quota wall. Measured 2026-08-25 over 42 real turns at a median 34 output tokens/sec on the billing-enabled project, versus 16 tok/sec on the free tier — so free-tier Gemma is throttled roughly 2x. Even at the faster paid rate it is 86% of wall-clock while costing nothing, which is the central cost-vs-latency inversion of this agent.

gemma-3-27b-it.note: RETIRED 2026-08-23 - returns 404 NOT_FOUND from AI Studio. Kept priced so historical turns.jsonl records that reference it still cost out; do not use for new runs.

gemma-3-12b-it.note: RETIRED 2026-08-23 - returns 404 NOT_FOUND from AI Studio. Same rationale as gemma-3-27b-it.

counterfactual_note: eval/aggregate_metrics.py reprices EVERY token (router + finalizer) at
counterfactual_model to answer: what would this cost as a single-model agent?
The reported saving is (counterfactual - actual) / counterfactual.
With gemma priced at 0 the saving is trivially the finalizer's whole share, so
the token-share breakdown is the honest headline number, not the dollar figure.
